title: demo.end (server → platform, ephemeral)
description: Proposed by Ready Up (FLEET.md §12.2). The recording stopped (after the GOTV flush) and the file is final. Sent on the same lowest-priority lane as demo.chunk, so it arrives after every chunk sent before it; sent again every 10 s until demo.ack complete. The platform: if stored < size → answer demo.ack {offset: stored} (the server sends the rest); else truncate its copy to size, hash it, and if the sha256 matches move it into place (demos/<match_id>/map<N>/<file>) and answer demo.ack {offset: size, complete: true} — also for a repeated demo.end of a demo it already stored. On a mismatch discard the copy and answer demo.ack {offset: 0, error: {code: "checksum"}}: the server starts over with demo.begin {restart: true} (at most 3 times, then it keeps the demo locally). Only after complete: true may the server delete its local file.

sha256.description: sha256 of the whole final file, lowercase hex.
